text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Nintendo Switch was released in 2017 as a hybrid console designed for both handheld and home gaming. Its detachable Joy-Con controllers allowed multiple play styles including portable play, tabletop mode, and traditional television gaming. The system combined handheld hardware with console features and received a large library including The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, Super Mario Odyssey, Animal Crossing: New Horizons, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, and Pokémon titles. The Switch became one of Nintendo's most successful systems and continued Nintendo's focus on unique hardware design and first-party software.
